conviction_note: The findings sum to +0.1 and the scaled number is -0.34 (abs 8.5 x p_up 48), so both are close to zero. The Q4 miss against plan is already in consensus: IFIS-based consensus OL is 12,037m against the 12,679m plan, after analysts cut targets 25-30% through Sep-Oct. The print turns on the first FY27 guide. On that guide the weak yen and two disappointing initial guides out of four argue down, while September SSS of +2.9% and the expectations reset argue up. abs_move is set at 8.5 rather than the 4.91 proxy because the name's reactions on its actual release dates have a median of about 7.8% over 19 prints, with four limit-sized moves since 2024.
bar: FY2026/8 ordinary-profit consensus 12,037m yen, cut from 12,394m on 2026-10-07 (kabuyoho / IFIS: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=3046), against the company plan of 12,679m (OP 12,772m), unchanged since the 2026-04-10 downward revision (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3046). The implied Q4 consensus OL is 3,023m (-6% YoY) against the plan's 3,665m (+13.5%). There is only one consensus source, so every size here is kept small. No FY2027 consensus was found anywhere.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts are 1.02% of shares outstanding, up from 0.97%, with one seller (as of 2026-09-29, baseline), so this is not a crowded short. The margin ratio (信用倍率) is 22.83, a heavily crowded leveraged long (baseline; kabutan shows the same figure on 2026-10-09). Goldman Sachs group large-holding filings: 5.29% on 2026-09-15, then 3.71% on 2026-09-30. Within that, GSAM International fell 3.04% -> 2.65% and GS International 1.87% -> 0.72% (the GSI move is likely prime/lending). Sources: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202609251037 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202610070987. There is no option skew in Japan. The baseline priced_lean is -0.114, roughly neutral.

findings.finding: Domestic eyewear Q4 (Jun-Aug) monthlies: all-store sales +5.8% and existing-store sales -1.2% (Jun -0.1, Jul -1.5, Aug -2.0), after +18.7% / +12.0% in Q3. The plan's implied Q4 OL is +13.5% YoY, Fisco flagged a stronger yen headwind to gross margin in Q4, and domestic segment OP was already -13.6% for 9M. So the FY plan is likely missed, but consensus has already moved to 12,037m (Q4 about -6%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q3 (2026-07-10, 16:00) progress was 71.1% against a 5-year average of 79.5% and the stock went limit-down, -19.38%. At Q1 (2026-01-09) OP came in below consensus and the stock fell 4.91%.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. The monthlies are public. The stock has fallen 30% from 8,040 before Q3 to 5,620. Consensus OL fell from 12,632m (Jul 22) to 12,037m (Oct 7), below the 12,679m plan, so a plan miss of the size the monthlies imply is already the street number. The only part left unpriced is the residual between actual and 12,037m, and the margin long at 22.8x is the one setup where a confirmed miss can still find sellers.
findings.independence: Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591181.pdf): domestic segment OP -13.6% on sales +13.0%. Fisco on 2026-07-13 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202607130728): gross margin falling, yen impact stronger in Q4.

findings.finding: September 2026, the first month of FY27: domestic existing-store sales +2.9% (first positive month in four) and all-store sales +10.0%, driven by higher spend per customer despite typhoons. This gives the FY27 guide a positive starting run-rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 2.68% on 10-06 before the release, then fell 1.39% on 10-07 on the release itself (kabutan: 反応限定的). Strong monthlies in spring 2026 brought +10.9% (May 11) and +6.2% (Jun 8).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the number is public and the stock fell on it. What is not priced is how the company turns a positive start, with 591 stores against a year-earlier base plus the flagship investment year being lapped, into its first FY27 OP guide. Had the market extrapolated September, the stock would have risen on 10-07 instead of slipping 1.4%.
findings.independence: kabutan/MINKABU article 2026-10-07 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202610070697), which reports the same document, so it does not count as independent.

findings.finding: The FY27 initial guide is likely to embed a weak-yen gross-margin headwind (USDJPY 158.1 on 2026-10-09 per the kabutan header, against the yen impact already cited for Q4). Last October's initial guide (OL +6%) came in under consensus and the stock fell 7.78% on 'コンセンサス下振れ'. October 2022 brought -7.89% on the same line, while October 2024 brought +19.38%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Full-year prints (new guide): 2022-10 -7.89%, 2023-10 +0.84%, 2024-10 +19.38%, 2025-10 -7.78% (Yahoo daily closes on the actual release dates).
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. No FY27 consensus is visible, and the 30% de-rating already discounts margin pressure. What is left is the risk that the company again guides conservatively under the yen assumption, which is what it did last October. If the market had fully priced a cautious guide, analysts would not still be calling for profit growth: the US-house Buy target is 7,300, 30% above spot. The inference runs from FX to company margin, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Fisco on the Q3 reaction (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202607130728): '円安のマイナス影響は第4四半期により強まる'.

findings.finding: Expectations have been reset hard into the print. The European house cut to Neutral (TP 8,600 -> 6,400 -> 6,300), the Japanese major cut its TP from 9,300 to 6,800, and the US house cut its TP from 8,600 to 7,300 (still Buy). FY26 OL consensus has fallen in four consecutive revisions, from 12,632m to 12,037m. The stock, at 5,620, sits below every published target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 print of 2026-04-10, a small downward revision after a lowered bar, brought +18.62% (limit-up), described as '下方修正幅は小幅にとどまり買い安心感'.
findings.why_not_priced: The cuts themselves are public. The point is that the bar for the print is now set below the company plan, so a result near consensus, or a FY27 guide that grows at all, clears it. The April 2026 precedent, a cut smaller than feared that went limit-up, shows this name pays for a lowered bar. Had the reset run its course, the stock would not be sitting at the January low after a -1.06% 20-day drift.
findings.independence: kabutan H1 reaction article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=n202604130248), a different event from a different source.

findings.finding: Crowded leveraged long and an institutional trim. The margin ratio is 22.83x. GSAM International reduced its stake from 3.04% to 2.65% between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-30, and the Goldman group total fell from 5.29% to 3.71%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the July 2026 Q3 print, after the long spring run with heavy retail participation, the stock went limit-down and then fell another 3.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Margin longs at 22.8x are forced sellers on a disappointment, which the price before the print cannot discount. The GSAM trim is small, and part of the group change is likely lending, so the finding is sized small.
findings.independence: Baseline margin_ratio 22.83 (broker scrape); kabutan finance page shows 信用倍率 22.83倍 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3046).

findings.finding: Capital returns: FY26 dividend plan 115 yen (payout about 31%) and no buyback in the record (FY25 CF shows none). The 100-share unit is about 562k yen, above the TSE 500k line, and the company's Rule 409 policy says it will 'carefully consider' lowering the unit, which leaves a small optional upside if a split comes with the results. Last year's FY print raised the prior-year dividend by 15 yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10: FY25 dividend raised 15 yen and FY26 raised 6 yen, yet the stock fell 7.78% because the guide dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no announced split or buyback, so any such news would be new. The probability is low, so the expected value is small. Last year's reaction shows returns do not override the guide for this name.
findings.independence: kabutan 2025-10-10 summary (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3046&b=k202510100109): '前期配当を15円増額・今期は6円増配へ'.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: FY26 ends at this print. A miss of about 5% against the 12,679m plan is expected and already in consensus at 12,037m. Returns: the 115 yen dividend is likely held; there is no buyback history and a split is only optional. New-year guide: FY27 is the main item, with no consensus visible; the yen at 158 and last year's under-consensus initial guide (-7.78%) argue down, while the September +2.9% SSS and the lapped flagship investment argue up. Quarter: 9M OL progress was 71.1% against a 5-year average of 79.5%, and Q4 monthlies show domestic SSS -1.2%.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.114) and the run-up (-1.06% over 20 days) are roughly neutral, and so is what I found. The strongest positive this release could carry is a FY27 guide showing double-digit OP growth as FY26 flagship costs are lapped and overseas grows, plus a held or raised dividend. I looked: there is no buyback history, no split commitment and no FY27 consensus. The strongest negative is a yen-burdened conservative guide hitting a 22.8x margin long. These roughly offset.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 or 進捗率): the Q4 monthly-miss finding goes from -0.3 to -0.1 and p_up moves toward 50.

Rule 2 (check the sign): negatives were three of six. I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. The FX-to-guide inference was trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8 as a proxy, p_up went from 47 to 48, and the expected move from -0.51 to -0.34.
